name: muse-spark-two-models
description: FORGE-0 with two Meta models in two roles: Muse Spark 1.3 (Meta Model API) forms the hypotheses; the open-weights Muse Spark Open (OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. Baseten) designs the experiments and writes the repairs. Requires META_API_KEY and OPENAI_COMPAT_API_KEY/BASE_URL/MODEL.
notes: A smoke test of the routing, not a capability comparison. The secondary model's structured output falls back to json_object (OPENAI_COMPAT_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT).
